identity.description: An attacker downloads a malicious binary to a temporary directory and executes it without code signing, triggering the 'Unsigned process running from a temporary directory' alert. Cortex should detect the unsigned process start from a temp path.

expected_artifacts.description: Unsigned process started from temp directory

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unsigned Process from Temp Directory
biocs.description: Detection of unsigned process execution from a temporary directory
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name contains '/tmp/' and actor_process_image_name not contains '.signed'
| filter actor_process_image_name not contains 'systemd'
| filter actor_process_image_name not contains 'bash'
